app.name: ITPMD Project Hub
app.themeNote: Anchor `ledger` with the prototype's exact LANDBANK tokens pinned in src/app-theme.css (primary #2F7D32, brand #74BC44, sidebar #123A1C, bg #F3F5F4; light + dark). Font IBM Plex Sans. Tokens only, no hex.
app.scope: MVP. Excluded: Discussion/chat (Phase 2), LEAF AI assistant (Phase 3), Liquidated damages tab + LD formula (Phase 2), sample-data reset, prototype user switcher, System Admin screens (users/roles/security/audit are Kissflow-native).
app.currency: PHP, formatted like the prototype: peso() = '₱' + millions with 2 decimals + 'M'; pesoFull() for invoice-level amounts
app.dates: fd() = '28 Sep 2026'; fds() = '28 Sep'. TODAY = client date.

shell.layout: Prototype .frame: fixed left rail (aside.side) + main column (top bar + content). Content uses list|detail split (section.list + main.detail) on Projects and Approvals; wide single column elsewhere. Mobile: rail collapses to drawer; list/detail stacks with a '‹ All projects' back button.

rail.surface: bg-sidebar (dark green #123A1C token) / text-sidebar-foreground; active item uses the brand accent token

logo.placement: top logo card, above product lockup

rail.roleAware: Resolve the signed-in user's app role(s) via kf.user / kf.app role APIs; render only items whose roles include one of them. If a user holds several roles, union the items. If current route is not allowed, redirect to the role landing.

dataScope.canEditActivity: canEditProject OR activity.responsible_person = me (Team Member: only percent_complete, actual_start, actual_finish per BR-15)

props.interaction: PM of project only: drag an unstarted, incomplete bar to move forecast_start/forecast_finish (and planned_start/planned_finish if no baseline yet); drag right edge to change forecast_finish; completed/started bars locked; persist via updateItem. No dependency cascade (see gaps).

props.title: Progress S-curve
props.compute: Activities of project, non-milestone (is_milestone false) and non-summary; weight w = planned_duration_days (fallback days between planned_start and planned_finish). Dates: weekly from project_start_date (fallback min baseline_start) to max(max_baseline_finish, max_forecast_finish), plus today. frac(s,f,at) = linear elapsed share. planned(at) = Σ w·frac(baseline_start, baseline_finish, at)/Σw·100 (fallback planned_start/finish if no baseline). actual(at<=today) = Σ w·(actual_finish ? 100 : percent_complete)/100·frac(actual_start, actual_finish||today, at). forecast(at>=today) = Σ w·(pct + (100-pct)·frac(max(today, forecast_start), forecast_finish, at))/100.
props.endLabels: right-side labels with final % per series

props.text: Reporting period: monthly · due by working day 5 of the following month (BR-11)

pages.title: Configuration
pages.layout: Left list of admin sections (Holiday calendar, Alert thresholds) + detail

props.title: Health and alert thresholds
props.readOnlyRules: Show the schedule/cost/contingency thresholds baked into Project formulas as read-only text: Schedule Amber >= 1 day, Red > 10 days or any missed milestone; Cost Amber > 100% or contingency >= 75%, Red > 105% or contingency >= 100%
props.edit: first ITPMD_Hub_Settings_A00 record (setting_name); edit via Form in Sheet, or create when none exists

gaps.prototype: Vendor, Notice of Award, Purchase Order no./date, Notice to Proceed, Contract expiry
gaps.reason: Live in the Project 'Contracts' child table per app-spec, but child tables are not in the synced kf-schema.json. Only contract_value (aggregate) is available. Builder may add them only after confirming the table via form.getFields().
Decision Log child table not in synced schema. Dropped.
No price field on ITPMD_Activity_A00. Column dropped.

gaps.where: Schedule table 'Pred.' column + Gantt dependency cascade
gaps.prototype: Predecessor ids; forecasts recalculated through dependencies
gaps.reason: Predecessors child table not in synced schema and there is no scheduling engine in the data layer. Drag in the Gantt moves only the dragged activity; no cascade.

gaps.where: Schedule 'Baseline vN · date' + History tab + Schedule change history
gaps.prototype: Baseline version, schedule history log, History tab
gaps.reason: Baseline History child table not in synced schema; no SDK API for Form item history. 'Set new baseline' rewrites baseline dates only. History tab dropped.

gaps.prototype: Working days (skips weekends and Bank holidays)
gaps.reason: schedule_variance_days is calendar-day DATEDIFF, and ITPMD_Holiday_Calendar_A00 is readable only by Hub Administrator. UI labels it 'days' rather than 'wd'.

gaps.where: Financials > Contingency draws list, Budget changes list, Record change/draw forms
gaps.prototype: Dated draw and change rows with reasons
gaps.reason: Budget Changes child table not in synced schema. Only totals (total_budget_changes, total_contingency_draws) are shown.
Invoices child table on Cost Entry not in synced schema. Dropped.
Team Member has no access to ITPMD_Cost_Entry_A00. Cost-entry widgets are gated; project-level totals still show.
No weekly progress snapshot series (BR-17) in the schema. Past actual values are interpolated from actual_start/actual_finish/percent_complete, same as the prototype.

gaps.where: PSR visibility for PSC Member and Team Member; portfolio 'Latest PSR' column
gaps.reason: Process SDK lists only my items, my tasks and participated items (getAdminItems needs admin). Non-initiator, non-approver roles may see an empty PSR list. Builder should verify live and show an empty state, not fake rows.
psr_due_working_day and holidays live in Hub Settings/Holiday Calendar, which only Hub Administrator can read. Shown as text 'working day 5 of the following month (BR-11)' instead of a computed date.

gaps.prototype: Only open risks/issues and undone actions count
gaps.reason: Risk/Issue escalation_flag and critical_flag, and Action overdue_flag, do not exclude Closed/Resolved/Done items, so Project counts may include closed items. Where item lists are loaded (tabs, notifications), the UI filters by status itself. Portfolio KPIs use the Project aggregates as-is.

gaps.prototype: Issue status (Open/In Progress/Escalated/Resolved/Closed), Action status (Open/In Progress/Overdue/Done)
gaps.reason: Synced schema lists no status or system fields for the Case models. Plan binds to the board system status '_status'; the builder must confirm the key via board.getFields(). Status moves go through board.openForm, not inline.
No notification model. The feed is derived live from data; there is no read/unread state.

gaps.where: Admin > Users, Roles and permissions, Security parameters, Audit trail, LEAF, LD formula
gaps.reason: No backing models (Kissflow-native admin) or Phase 2/3. Excluded.
Hard-coded in Project formula fields, not in Hub Settings. Shown read-only.
Out of scope for the custom UI; the PPSR can be saved as an ITPMD_Portfolio_Status_Report_A00 record.
Project Manager has no access to ITPMD_Portfolio_Status_Report_A00; button gated (hidden for PM).
